name: coleo
description: AI agent orchestrator using the Octopus Model

scripts.build: bun run setup && bun run --cwd src/web build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r src/web/dist/ dist/web/ && mkdir -p dist/brain && cp -r src/brain/templates dist/brain/templates && bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.check: bun run shellcheck && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration:spec
scripts.test:unit: bun test src/agent/__tests__/ src/api/__tests__/ src/api/routes/__tests__/ src/arm/__tests__/ src/brain/__tests__/ src/cli/__tests__/ src/config/__tests__/ src/embedding/__tests__/ src/harness/__tests__/ src/lib/__tests__/ src/mail/__tests__/ src/mcp/__tests__/ src/mcp/config/__tests__/ src/nats/__tests__/ src/qdrant/__tests__/ src/scripts/__tests__/ src/vector/__tests__/ src/web/__tests__/
scripts.test:watch: bun test --watch src/agent/__tests__/ src/api/__tests__/ src/api/routes/__tests__/ src/arm/__tests__/ src/brain/__tests__/ src/cli/__tests__/ src/config/__tests__/ src/embedding/__tests__/ src/harness/__tests__/ src/lib/__tests__/ src/mail/__tests__/ src/mcp/__tests__/ src/mcp/config/__tests__/ src/nats/__tests__/ src/scripts/__tests__/ src/vector/__tests__/ src/web/__tests__/
scripts.dev:core: concurrently --prefix-colors 'cyan,blue' --names 'api,brain' 'bun run src/cli/index.ts serve start' 'bun run brain'
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --prefix-colors 'cyan,blue,green' --names 'api,brain,web' 'bun run src/cli/index.ts serve start' 'bun run brain' 'bun run web:dev'
scripts.dev:core:restart: bun run src/cli/index.ts serve restart && bun run src/cli/index.ts brain restart
scripts.dev:core:stop: bun run src/cli/index.ts serve stop; bun run src/cli/index.ts brain stop
